#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Request / event validation tests."""
import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile, os

SUB = "/workspace/submission/main.py"
CFG = {"version": 1, "idle_timeout": 10, "packet_limit": 5, "prefix_width": 2,
       "rules": [{"id": 7, "class": 2, "priority": 10, "ranges": [[100, 105], [-60, -60]]}],
       "fallback": {"feature": 0, "threshold": 0, "le": {"class": 8}, "gt": {"class": 9}}}

def compile_prog():
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", SUB, "compile"], input=json.dumps(CFG).encode(),
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=60)
    assert p.returncode == 0
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    path = os.path.join(d, "program.json")
    open(path, "w").write(json.dumps(json.loads(p.stdout)))
    return path

def stream(path, lines, expect_rc, expect=None):
    data = "".join(l if l.endswith("\n") else l + "\n" for l in lines).encode()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", SUB, "stream", path], input=data,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=120)
    out = p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
    ok = True
    if p.returncode != expect_rc:
        print("FAIL rc %d != %d (stderr %r)" % (p.returncode, expect_rc, p.stderr[:200])); ok = False
    if expect is not None:
        exp = expect if isinstance(expect, list) else [expect]
        if out != exp:
            print("FAIL out %s != %s" % (out[:4], exp[:4])); ok = False
    return ok, out

fails = 0
def t(name, lines, expect_rc, expect=None):
    global fails, path
    ok, out = stream(path, lines, expect_rc, expect)
    if not ok:
        print("  in test:", name, lines[:3]); fails += 1
    return out

path = compile_prog()
J = json.dumps

t("simple", [J({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}), J({"op":"close","flow":1,"time":0})], 0,
  ['{"events":[]}',
   '{"events":[{"type":"decision","flow":1,"class":9,"reason":"end","at":0,"time":0,"rule":null},{"type":"closed","flow":1,"packets":0,"matches":0,"class":9,"reason":"end","rule":null}]}'])

t("unknown op", [J({"op":"nope","time":1})], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("op not string", [J({"op":1})], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("request array", ["[1,2]"], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("malformed", ["{oops"], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("blank line", [""], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("whitespace line", ["   "], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("nan", ['{"op":"tick","time":NaN}'], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("dup key", ['{"op":"tick","op":"tick","time":1}'], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("extra key", [J({"op":"tick","time":1,"x":2})], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("missing key", [J({"op":"tick"})], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("time float", [J({"op":"tick","time":1.0})], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("time bool", [J({"op":"tick","time":True})], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("time neg", [J({"op":"tick","time":-1})], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("time too big", [J({"op":"tick","time":2**53})], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("time max ok", [J({"op":"tick","time":2**53-1})], 0, ['{"events":[]}'])
t("open dup", [J({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}), J({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":1})], 2,
  ['{"events":[]}', '{"error":"event"}'])
t("close absent", [J({"op":"close","flow":9,"time":0})], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("packet absent", [J({"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":9,"time":0,"source":0,"length":1}]})], 2,
  ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("packet bad source", [J({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}), J({"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":0,"source":2,"length":1}]})], 2,
  ['{"events":[]}', '{"error":"event"}'])
t("packet bad length", [J({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}), J({"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":0,"source":0,"length":0}]})], 2,
  ['{"events":[]}', '{"error":"event"}'])
t("packet length 2049", [J({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}), J({"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":0,"source":0,"length":2049}]})], 2,
  ['{"events":[]}', '{"error":"event"}'])
t("packet missing key", [J({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}), J({"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":0,"source":0}]})], 2,
  ['{"events":[]}', '{"error":"event"}'])
t("packet extra key", [J({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}), J({"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":0,"source":0,"length":1,"z":0}]})], 2,
  ['{"events":[]}', '{"error":"event"}'])
t("packets not list", [J({"op":"chunk","packets":5})], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("decreasing time", [J({"op":"tick","time":5}), J({"op":"tick","time":4})], 2,
  ['{"events":[]}', '{"error":"event"}'])
t("decreasing in chunk", [J({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":5}), J({"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":5,"source":0,"length":1},{"flow":1,"time":4,"source":0,"length":1}]})], 2,
  ['{"events":[]}', '{"error":"event"}'])
t("open time decreasing", [J({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":5}), J({"op":"open","flow":2,"time":4})], 2,
  ['{"events":[]}', '{"error":"event"}'])
t("close time decreasing", [J({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":5}), J({"op":"close","flow":1,"time":4})], 2,
  ['{"events":[]}', '{"error":"event"}'])
t("empty chunk", [J({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":5}), J({"op":"chunk","packets":[]}), J({"op":"close","flow":1,"time":5})], 0,
  ['{"events":[]}', '{"events":[]}',
   '{"events":[{"type":"decision","flow":1,"class":9,"reason":"end","at":0,"time":5,"rule":null},{"type":"closed","flow":1,"packets":0,"matches":0,"class":9,"reason":"end","rule":null}]}'])
t("restore not first", [J({"op":"tick","time":5}), J({"op":"restore","checkpoint":{}})], 2,
  ['{"events":[]}', '{"error":"event"}'])
t("checkpoint extra key", [J({"op":"checkpoint","x":1})], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("restore missing", [J({"op":"restore"})], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("flow id too big", [J({"op":"open","flow":2**31,"time":0})], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("flow id max ok", [J({"op":"open","flow":2**31-1,"time":0})], 0, ['{"events":[]}'])
t("huge int time", ['{"op":"tick","time":' + "9"*8192 + '}'], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])
t("8192-digit int parses", ['{"op":"checkpoint","checkpoint":{"x":' + "9"*8192 + '}}'], 2, ['{"error":"event"}'])

# too many open flows
lines = [J({"op":"open","flow":i,"time":0}) for i in range(4096)]
t("4096 opens", lines, 0, ['{"events":[]}'] * 4096)
lines2 = lines + [J({"op":"open","flow":99999,"time":0})]
t("4097th open", lines2, 2, ['{"events":[]}'] * 4096 + ['{"error":"event"}'])

# close one then open again
lines3 = lines + [J({"op":"close","flow":0,"time":0}), J({"op":"open","flow":50000,"time":0})]
t("close then open", lines3, 0, None)

# no trailing newline on last request
data = J({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0})
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", SUB, "stream", path], input=data.encode(),
                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=60)
if p.returncode != 0 or p.stdout != b'{"events":[]}\n':
    print("FAIL no trailing newline: %r %r" % (p.returncode, p.stdout[:100])); fails += 1

# EOF with no input
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", SUB, "stream", path], input=b"",
                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=60)
if p.returncode != 0 or p.stdout != b"":
    print("FAIL empty stdin: %r %r" % (p.returncode, p.stdout[:100])); fails += 1

# blank line at very end (after a valid request) is still malformed
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", SUB, "stream", path],
                   input=(J({"op":"tick","time":0}) + "\n\n").encode(),
                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=60)
if p.returncode != 2 or p.stdout != b'{"events":[]}\n{"error":"event"}\n':
    print("FAIL trailing blank: %r %r" % (p.returncode, p.stdout[:200])); fails += 1

print("failures:", fails)
PYEOF
